completionEvidence.description: Five consecutive TestQemuProviderIntegration rounds passed. Round wall-clock times were 31.69s, 31.20s, 30.74s, 29.18s and 31.30s; the Go test durations were 31.65s, 31.17s, 30.70s, 29.15s and 31.25s. Mean wall time 30.82s, min 29.18s, max 31.69s.

Every round exercised create overlay, QEMU/WHPX start, guest login prompt, provider restart reconciliation with the original PID, idempotent StartVm/StopVm, ACPI graceful stop, qcow2 snapshot create/restore and DeleteVm. Any step failure would have produced a Go test failure.
No residual qemu-system-x86_64 process was observed after any round or at the end; no go-provider-smoke VM directory was left behind after the five passing rounds.
Harness summary and per-round Go test stdout/stderr logs.

notes: Rounds used the default storage root %LOCALAPPDATA%\AgentInBox\vms-go and the noble server seed image. One earlier harness attempt was discarded because Start-Process -PassThru returned an empty ExitCode on this host and the harness incorrectly marked a real PASS as failed; the harness was switched to System.Diagnostics.Process. The five rounds counted here are clean and all reported exit code 0. Together with the four earlier passes at 17:51-17:52 (33.18s, 31.73s, 31.27s, 31.27s), nine runs passed across roughly two hours.
